heroHeadline: Israel Security Cabinet Weighs Full-Scale Gaza War Resumption as Hamas Disarmament Collapses; Protests Demand October 7 Probe — Day 940
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. On May 3, 2026 (Day 939), Israel's security cabinet convened an emergency session to formally weigh scenarios for resuming full-scale military operations in Gaza, as Hamas categorically rejected Phase Two disarmament talks and all four Board of Peace deadlines passed without agreement; the IDF has been readying operational plans for a new ground offensive to force Hamas demilitarization by military means. On May 2 (Day 938), approximately 1,000 protesters rallied at Tel Aviv's Habima Square demanding an independent October 7 state commission of inquiry and an end to Haredi draft exemptions — former minister Izhar Shay declared the government must answer 'under oath.' An external IDF panel found that most internal October 7 probes were 'inadequate,' with key findings omitted from public reports (May 3, Day 939). The Israeli Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 deadline for the government to establish an October 7 investigation framework is driving sustained political pressure — 74% of Israelis support a fully independent commission, including 68% of Netanyahu's base. Global diplomatic fallout from the April 30 Global Sumud Flotilla interception and Ben-Gvir's screening of the 43-minute October 7 horror video to 175 detained activists continued through May 1 (Day 937), with Turkey calling it 'piracy' and Italy demanding its citizens' release. Cumulative Palestinian death toll since October 7, 2023 exceeds 72,600+ (OCHA/Gaza MoH); 830+ killed since the October 2025 ceasefire began (Ceasefire Day 207).
